ratification: Nothing here is recorded or binding until the operator ratifies it: sending an AUTHORIZE line after reading this file ratifies the figures as written (the execution line ratifies W01 and W02, the audit-route line ratifies W03 and the audit); replying with changed numbers replaces them.
enforcement: Coordinator-enforced from wall-clock timestamps and counted calls. Not enforced by ct. Exceeding any figure means STOP and NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with evidence; no self-extension.
basis: First measured history exists: the R2 macro ran W01 and W02 (model children) in about 10 minutes of wall clock in total and the audit stage in about 3 minutes of run time (143.6 s) for USD 0.0712 including two probes. This macro has no model children, so its figures are estimates for deterministic work with generous margin.

time_semantics.active: minutes of team-lead work, excluding operator-gate waits
time_semantics.elapsed: wall-clock minutes from start to return, excluding operator-gate waits

W03.executor: team lead, local-shell, plus the single external audit call
W03.note: the model call is the one audit; the two content-free containment probes are not audit attempts

per_macro.coordinator_tokens: UNKNOWN (not recordable from this runner); not enforced

audit.cost_note: recorded only if the stream reports it; otherwise UNKNOWN
audit.artifact_custody: prompt, raw stream, probes, response, run record and hashes copied into the review bundle and committed before the verdict is read; a missing raw stream voids the audit
audit.proposal_only: The route is operator-gated: AUDITOR_BINDING_PROPOSED.json is not recorded, selected or run by the execution line.

review.after_freeze: Any semantic change after M is frozen invalidates the audit and needs a new operator line; proof-only commits do not.
review.after_audit_fail_or_pass_with_risks: No automatic repair loop. FAIL or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR returns to the operator.

staleness: The pins (main tip, PR head) go stale the moment main or feat/pulse-001 moves; the package is then re-issued with new pins rather than adapted at run time.
